title: Evaluate command lifecycle and dashboard state ownership
description: Compare authoritative lifecycle ownership and dashboard synchronization options before implementing a projection. Evaluate correctness, user experience, operational cost, and portability across deployment targets. Record a defensible recommendation, rejection criteria, and validation plan without client-specific information.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Completed the ownership comparison and documented the decision. Evidence considered: the AWS TaskDispatcher conditionally claims PENDING tasks, but current task dispatch does not provide renewable leases, fencing tokens, immutable request identity, or portable authoritative lifecycle semantics. The record compares dashboard-authoritative state, dedicated lifecycle plus projection, and separate logical schemas in one database. Validation: git diff --check.
